record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Does the separable complementation property imply the m-complementation property for every cardinal m? For a Banach space X, the separable complementation property means that every separable subspace E of X is contained in a separable complemented subspace F of X. The m-complementation property means that every subspace E of X with density character m is contained in a complemented subspace F of X with density character m.

evidence.quote: We say that X has the separable complementation property (SCP) if for every separable subspace E of X there is a separable complemented subspace E ⊂ F ⊂ X.
We say that X has the m-complementation property (m-CP) if for every subspace E of X with dens E = m there is a complemented subspace E ⊂ F ⊂ X with dens F = m.
Problem 6.1. Does the SCP imply the m-CP?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a Banach space. For a closed subspace $E \subseteq X$, the density character $\operatorname{dens} E$ is the least cardinality of a dense subset of $E$. Say that $X$ has the separable complementation property (SCP) if every separable closed subspace $E$ of $X$ is contained in a separable closed subspace $F$ of $X$ that is complemented in $X$ (i.e., $F$ is the range of a bounded linear projection $X \to X$). For an infinite cardinal $\mathfrak{m}$, say that $X$ has the $\mathfrak{m}$-complementation property ($\mathfrak{m}$-CP) if every closed subspace $E$ of $X$ with $\operatorname{dens} E = \mathfrak{m}$ is contained in a complemented closed subspace $F$ of $X$ with $\operatorname{dens} F = \mathfrak{m}$.

Question: Does the SCP imply the $\mathfrak{m}$-CP for every infinite cardinal $\mathfrak{m}$? That is, if a Banach space $X$ has the separable complementation property, must $X$ have the $\mathfrak{m}$-complementation property for every infinite cardinal $\mathfrak{m}$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a definitive resolution of the implication SCP ⇒ 𝔪-CP for all infinite cardinals 𝔪. Related literature (Plichko, Yost, and others) discusses SCP and its connections with M-bases and Plichko spaces, but no source clearly states whether the general implication has been proved or refuted. Status appears unresolved in the accessible search evidence.

status_evidence.title: Complemented and uncomplemented subspaces of Banach spaces (Plichko–Yost)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on complementation properties of non-separable Banach spaces, including SCP and density-character variants.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference discussing SCP and related higher-density complementation notions, without a definitive statement that SCP implies 𝔪-CP in general.

status_evidence.title: Lipschitz retractions and complementation properties of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on complementation properties of Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to study complementation properties at various density characters, suggesting the general question is not closed by a well-known theorem.
